latent_state.name: z_analysis
latent_state.source: Agent1 assimilation output or declared FEM oracle upper bound

node_observation.missing_value_policy: value is zero-filled only after normalization; mask remains an input

known_history.maintenance_state_reset: [inspection_time, 1] boolean; required true when a historical maintenance event changes the analysis-state semantics

future_scenario.maintenance: [scenario_horizon, maintenance_channel]; a non-zero plan requires a declared maintenance-effect model id

hard_rules: FEM eta0 remains the physical numerical reference
synthetic and real observations must never share an unlabeled row
psi_raw, fatigue history, degradation, and active driver are not direct road measurements
cycle index, cycle/89, future failure cycle, and repeated windows as pseudo-road samples are forbidden
all compared models receive identical observed origins, masks, scenarios, seeds, and budgets
